top_choice_rationale: Base editing is a defined chemical step on DNA, a deaminase positioned by a programmable nickase, with the evolved TadA adenine deaminase (Gaudelli) and the cytosine editor (Komor) as the two decisive, widely reproduced demonstrations under Liu's programme. Crediting all three fits the single-achievement prize and avoids a Liu-only allocation that omits the first-author inventors. P001 follows because it pairs the same achievement with PROTAC degradation, which I value, but Liu alone understates Komor and Gaudelli and no PROTAC is yet an approved drug. P003 and P004 each carry the same Liu-only base-editing credit; I place the mature, independently validated C-N coupling ahead of dye-sensitized cells, whose practical impact has faded. No award is last because a well-reproduced, mechanistically quantified achievement is available.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; base editing bears on genome maintenance but no direct tie to the candidates is evident
